result.topic_en: The velocity of the aether is decomposed into a curl-free, divergence-free part and a divergence-free part satisfying wave equations; the resulting equations for the actual velocity are written with sources X_1, X_2, X_3 derived from a potential U.
result.transcription:
Nach der zu Anfang gemachten Voraussetzung
resultirt also die Geschwindigkeit $\eta_1',\eta_2',\eta_3'$ einer
Resultante aus den Geschwindigkeiten:
$\eta_1',\eta_2',\eta_3'$
für welche die Bedingungen gelten
$\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_1}+\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_2}+\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_3}=0;\ \frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_3}-\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_2}=0;\ \frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_1}-\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_3}=0;\ \frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_2}-\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_1}=0$
und aus den
$\eta_1',\eta_2',\eta_3'$ für welche:
$\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_1}+\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_2}+\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_3}=0;\ \{cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t\}\eta_1'=0;\ (cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)\eta_2'=0;\ (cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)\eta_3'=0$

Es sind also die entsprechenden Summen
dieser Componenten der Geschwindigkeit
gleich den Componenten der wirklich stattfindenden
Geschwindigkeit; für letztere gelten also {+deren+} die
Gleichungen:
$\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_1}+\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_2}+\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_3}=0$
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)(\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_3}-\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_2})=0$
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)(\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_1}-\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_3})=0$
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)(\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_2}-\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_1})=0$
wie sich leicht ergiebt, wenn man die Operationen ausführt.
Die letzten drei dieser Gleichungen lassen
sich auch so ausdrücken:
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)\eta_1'=X_1$
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)\eta_2'=X_2$
$(cc(\partial^2_{\eta_1}+\partial^2_{\eta_2}+\partial^2_{\eta_3})-\partial^2_t)\eta_3'=X_3$
$dU=X_1d\eta_1+X_2d\eta_2+X_3d\eta_3$
oder auch:
$\frac{\partial\eta_1'}{\partial\eta_1}+\frac{\partial\eta_2'}{\partial\eta_2}+\frac{\partial\eta_3'}{\partial\eta_3}=0$
$\int(X_1\delta\eta_1'+X_2\delta\eta_2'+X_3\delta\eta_3')\,d\eta_1d\eta_2d\eta_3=0$

methods.what: Decomposition of the velocity field into an irrotational divergence-free part and a divergence-free part satisfying the wave equation
Divergence-free condition for the actual velocity
Wave operator applied to curl components vanishes
Equivalent form: wave operator on velocity equals gradient of a potential U
Variational (weak) form: X orthogonal to all divergence-free variations

items.quote: wie sich leicht ergiebt, wenn man die Operationen ausführt.
items.english: as is easily obtained if one carries out the operations.
